description: This Java source file defines a JAX-RS REST resource class for handling batch API requests in the Apache Fineract project. It provides HTTP endpoints for processing batch operations, serializes/deserializes request and response objects, performs validation, and delegates processing to a service layer.

classes.name: BatchApiResource
classes.description: A REST resource class providing batch processing endpoints for the Fineract API, supporting execution of multiple requests with dependency handling, transactional control, and validation.

methods.name: handleBatchRequests
methods.description: Handles batch request POST API calls; validates user, checks request methods based on mode, and delegates processing to the service layer, returning a list of batch responses.

methods.name: validateRequestMethodsAllowedOnInstanceType
methods.description: Validates that batch requests do not contain write operations if the server is in read-only mode; throws exception if validation fails.
